lines.text: There. [pause] No more mask. [pause] You should see your faces. [chuckles] I did warn you.
Did you really think a little stitched leather could hide me? [pause] From you? [pause] I hid from far worse.
The Doctor is in. [pause] And I am afraid the Doctor is very, very disappointed in you.
The voices told me you would come. [pause] They never lie. [pause] Unlike me.
My children. [pause] Come. [pause] Come and meet our guests.
One. One. Five. [pause] The whole tower runs on it. [pause] So do I. [pause] For now.
You want to know what I did with the little girl. [pause] So does she.
No. [pause] No, that is quite enough. [pause] Let us begin. [pause] Properly, this time.
